what: Which payslip items count as EPF wages, and where SOCSO/EIS differ. Not year-dependent on current evidence: Act A1760 did not change s.2. Use one shared table for 2025, 2026 and the 2027 template.
test: Act 452 s.2: wages are 'all remuneration in money, due to an employee under his contract of service or apprenticeship', including 'any bonus, commission or allowance ... whether ... payable under his contract of service, apprenticeship or otherwise'. Excludes service charge, overtime, gratuity, retirement benefit, retrenchment/lay-off/termination benefits, 'any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession', and anything the Minister exempts. Substance beats the label. KWSP says its non-wage list 'is not exhaustive'.

confidenceLabels.inferred: Researcher's reading; no source states it

components.label: Annual bonus
components.note: Contractual or not, for EPF. May trigger the Part A/C bonus note.

components.label: Non-annual bonus
components.note: The SOCSO/EIS exclusion names annual bonus only.

components.label: Commission
components.note: Does not trigger the bonus note (medium).

components.label: Arrears
components.note: Increment arrears go to the actual month (FAQ Q17).

components.label: Unused annual or medical leave pay
Paid maternity, study and half-day leave
Driver's trip allowance
components.note: KWSP FAQ Q23; Cold Chain (2017, press reports of an oral ruling).

components.label: Fixed transport, petrol, toll or parking allowance
components.note: Vendors and a law firm say subject. s.2(f) and KWSP's 2012 definition draw no fixed-versus-claim line. No KWSP test found. Owner question.

components.label: Mileage claim for actual business trips
components.note: Distance-based pay where the employer bears the running costs is wages.

components.label: Toll or parking claim at actual cost
On-call / standby payment
components.note: Hours worked beyond normal hours are overtime instead.

components.label: Genuine expense reimbursement
components.note: For EPF this rests on the meaning of 'remuneration', not s.2's wording. A label alone is not enough.

components.label: Non-cash benefits and perquisites
components.note: Cash in lieu is an allowance and subject.

components.label: Ex-gratia on completion, resignation or retrenchment
components.note: Gratuity or termination benefit under s.2.

components.label: Festive cash gift
components.note: Some vendors exempt it. KWSP does not list gifts. Could be a bonus under 'or otherwise'.

components.label: Director's fee
components.note: KWSP's 2012 page lists it. Fees paid to an owner or executive director are a grey area.

components.label: Overtime, including holiday and rest-day work
Service charge
components.note: EIS is the recorded practical reading, not a PERKESO list.

components.label: Tips from customers
components.note: SOCSO/EIS by inference: not paid 'by an employer'.

components.label: Pay in lieu of notice
components.note: KWSP FAQ Q11. Not named in s.2.

components.label: Share options
components.note: No local authority, per Donovan & Ho (2018). Cash-settled awards could be subject. RSUs: no source found.

limits: kwsp.gov.my returned 403. KWSP's Employer Guide Book and its 2014 FAQ images of wage components were not read; they are the most likely way to settle fixedTransport, cashGift and directorFee. SOCSO and EIS values are recorded from this research and belong to those schemes' reports.
sources: KWSP employer FAQ Q8, Q11, Q19, Q21, Q22, Q23, Q28, capture 2026-08-10: https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/employer/responsibilities/mandatory-contribution
